findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: text_card, og_image, launch_kit · Private data: vista_avatar, compare_addresses, wallet_portrait, og_image, launch_kit, buy_studio_pass, payment_options · Public sink: text_card, logo_kit, launch_kit, buy_studio_pass · Destructive: vista_avatar, og_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: text_card, og_image, launch_kit · Private data: vista_avatar, compare_addresses, wallet_portrait, og_image, launch_kit, buy_studio_pass, payment_options · Public sink: text_card, logo_kit, launch_kit, buy_studio_pass · Destructive: vista_avatar, og_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
